messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a weekend or a weekday that creates a three‑day break.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend/Weekday | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-----------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | **Sunday, Jan 1** | Weekend | **Jan 1–2** (New Year’s Day + weekend) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island) | **Monday, Feb 20** | Weekday | **Feb 20–21** |
| Victoria Day | **Monday, May 22** | Weekday | **May 22–23** |
| Canada Day | **Saturday, Jul 1** | Weekend | **Jul 1–3** (Canada Day + weekend) |
| Labour Day | **Monday, Sep 4** | Weekday | **Sep 4–5** |
| Thanksgiving | **Monday, Oct 9** | Weekday | **Oct 9–10** |

> **Note:**  
> - Some holidays (e.g., Family Day) are province‑specific; the table lists the provinces where the holiday is observed.  
> - If you need the exact dates for a specific province or additional holidays (e.g., Civic Holiday, St. Patrick’s Day, etc.), let me know and I can refine the list.
